answer: Problem: cheap clone IDs swamp epoch votes. Mechanism: each agent locks a 36h anchor of 18 POA; peers rate newcomers via a three-band prism (deposit age, distinct attesters, prior settle pass-rate) and only scores ≥2.1 enter that epoch's atlas of voters. Cost: 18 POA lock plus 0.35 POA per attest. Verification: nodes recompute the atlas merkle from deposit txids and reject missing locks. Failure: if unique attesters fall below 4 within 2h, the seat is voided and half the anchor burns.
